From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Sep 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + MAP draft (proposed milestones & signature runway)

Hi Sam / Rebecca —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery and the MAP (attached) we discussed. I pulled together the proposed milestones, owners, and a conservative procurement signature runway so you have a single source of truth while you surface this internally.

High-level proposed MAP (emerald_MAP_v1.xlsx attached):
- Milestone 1 — Requirements sign-off (owner: Rebecca) — target: 2026-10-22
- Milestone 2 — SOC2 evidence & security review (owner: Emerald security) — target: 2026-10-29
- Milestone 3 — Legal redlines returned (owner: Emerald legal) — target: 2026-11-08
- Milestone 4 — PO & procurement approval (owner: Procurement) — target: 2026-11-12
- Target close / go-live: 2026-11-20
- Procurement / contract signature deadline (hard runway): 2026-11-15 (to allow 5 business days for DocuSign and SSO onboarding)

Dependencies / blockers we flagged on the call:
- SOC2 evidence (controls matrix + last assessment) — required before production access
- Data residency confirmation for EU subset (if applicable) — may affect infra placement
- Procurement timeline / PO process (internal approvals and treasury)

Ask / next steps:
1) Can you confirm the internal owners above (Rebecca + Procurement contact)?
2) Is the 2026-11-15 signature runway realistic for your procurement calendar, or should we shift the target close?
3) If legal prefers a redline session, we can schedule a focused contract review (30–45m) to speed turnaround.

I attached the MAP v1 and a short agenda for a contract redline working session. If the signature runway is tight, propose we schedule the redline session the week of Oct 12 to keep the legal loop moving.

Thanks — happy to adjust the dates if you need.

Best,

—
Soogin Lee
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com

Subject: Re: Post-call recap + MAP draft (proposed milestones & signature runway)

Thanks Soojin — appreciate the clear breakdown. Quick responses from our side: 

- Rebecca is confirmed as the requirements owner.
- Procurement has been looped (cc'd). Our procurement calendar has a review window that runs the week starting Nov 15, so the absolute latest our team can sign is 2026-11-18 (end of that business week). If we slip further past that week we risk the fiscal cutoff for this quarter.
- Legal asked that we add a dedicated budget-approval milestone (owner: Finance) with a delivery date of 2026-11-08 so they can tie redlines to the approved budget.

We'd like the MAP to reflect:
- Budget approval by 2026-11-08 (owner: Finance)
- Legal redlines by 2026-11-10 (owner: Legal)
- Procurement signature by 2026-11-18

Can you update the MAP to reflect procurement's runway and the additional budget milestone? If you can keep the contract redline session in the Oct 12–16 window, that will help.

On a separate note — can you share the SOC2 controls matrix (or point me to the artifact) so our security team can start the mapping?

Sam
